children.value: The dosing model simulates chemical dosing systems used in water treatment processes. It can operate in two modes: constant dosing or setpoint-controlled dosing, where the dosage is automatically adjusted to achieve a target water quality parameter.
The dosing model inherits from both the base
class, enabling it to handle mass balance calculations and chemical addition processes.
